text: The Seoul Metropolitan Government 2025 Summer Disaster Management Plan is an integrated, multi-hazard program designed to address heat waves, flooding, strong winds, and related public health risks in Seoul, South Korea. The plan operates from early May through mid-October 2025 and includes city-level early warning systems, engineered controls on flood-prone corridors, and widespread heat-health interventions for vulnerable groups. It also features pilot deployments of new flood alert technologies in select neighborhoods. The plan is part of a broader national effort to enhance seasonal readiness and resilience against climate-amplified extremes.
